# `dashboard/routes/instances.ts`

## Overview

This module manages instance routing for the dashboard. It provides utilities for tracking and accessing live preview instance information via an in-memory map.

---

## Exports

### `getLiveMap`

Returns the current read-only map of live preview instances, keyed by instance identifier string.

> **Note:** This function is not directly exported from the module's public surface. Import it using:
> ```ts
> import { getLiveMap } from '..'
> ```

#### Signature

```ts
function getLiveMap(): ReadonlyMap<string, PreviewInfo>
```

#### Parameters

None.

#### Returns

| Type | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `ReadonlyMap<string, PreviewInfo>` | A read-only map where each key is a `string` instance identifier and each value is a `PreviewInfo` object describing the corresponding live preview instance. |

#### Example

```ts
import { getLiveMap } from '..';

const liveInstances = getLiveMap();

for (const [id, info] of liveInstances) {
  console.log(`Instance ID: ${id}`, info);
}
```
